en.hubeali:
Humeyd Bin Ziyad, from Al Hassan Bin Muhammad Bin Sama’at, from Ahmad Bin Al Hassan Al Maysami, from Aban Bin usman, from Bassam Al Sayrafi, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Ja’far<sup style="font-weight: normal">asws</sup>
regarding the dung-eating camel having said: ‘Do not eat its meat, nor ride it for forty days’.
en.sarwar: 11. Humayd ibn Ziyad has narrated from al-Hassan ibn Muhammad ibn Sama‘ah from Ahmad ibn al-Hassan al-Mithamiy from Aban ibn ‘Uthman from Bassam al=Sayrafiy
who has said the following: “About the case of a camel that feeds on feces, abu Ja‘far, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, has said, ‘It cannot be used for food or riding for forty days.’”
